futureMechanisms: 场下精灵持续事件观察

success.name: 4925/2546实际命中自身全HP直接消耗，不受盾罩粉免/保1影响；整招无效不消耗，不拿当前人冒充场下复活对象
success.assertion: test('4925/2546实际命中自身全HP直接消耗，不受盾罩粉免/保1影响；整招无效不消耗，不拿当前人冒充场下复活对象',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','invalid']){const s=make({...row(2546),hp:5000});if(mode==='immune'){timer(s,0,'固定百分比免疫');timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'statusBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='invalid'?5000:0);if(mode!=='invalid'){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.doctorReviveRequest2546.health,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.doctorReviveRequest2546.onActualExit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9000);}else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.doctorReviveRequest2546,undefined);}});

success.name: 4925全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP与2120原生首轮，2546实际自身归零及不伪造场下复活

interaction.assertion: test('4925全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP与2120原生首轮，2546实际自身归零及不伪造场下复活',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp===0,m.id===29409);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.doctor2120.sleepDuration,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp===0,m.id===29409);}});
